company.description: Atlia provides AI-native management services for short-term rental properties listed on platforms such as Airbnb and Vrbo. Its service coordinates guest communication, cleaning and turnover activities, maintenance management, and guest inquiries. Atlia combines property-specific software with local operating teams to manage routine rental operations for property owners. The company charges a flat management fee for these services.
